name: air-os
description: AIR OS — a touchless, gesture-driven interface running entirely in the browser.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @airos/shared && npm run build -w @airos/web && npm run build -w @airos/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @airos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @airos/web && npm run typecheck -w @airos/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @airos/web && npm run lint -w @airos/server
